Contrapuntal movement: 0 none, 1 ATK, 2 EM, 3 Stellar Glimmer

effect.name: Forged by the Golden Melody · movement1
effect.description: Every 10s, the equipping character plays a "Harmonic Movement" of the corresponding type for a boost in the following order: +18%/22.5%/27%/31.5%/36% ATK > +120/150/180/210/240 Elemental Mastery > +28%/35%/42%/49%/56% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Each instance of Harmonic Movement lasts 10s. This effect can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction will also grant an additional 12-second instance of "Harmonic Movement: Contrapuntal" with the same effects as the Harmonic Movement active when Stellar Glimmer is triggered. This effect stacks with the original Harmonic Movement effect, and can trigger once every 12s. Combat snapshot: set the controls for this hit; durations, stack consumption, healing, energy and cooldowns are not simulated.
